name: @beats/openapi-types
description: Regenerates client/shared/api/generated.ts from openapi.json. A workspace package of its own for the same reason ui/tools/openapi-types is: openapi-typescript drives the TypeScript compiler API (ts.factory), which typescript@7 no longer exposes, so it gets a TypeScript 5 of its own and the back office's compiler stays on 7.
